text_block_list.text:
I brought the injured Sounds of Earth to 
the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haha... I really messed up, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Please, do not wear such a sorrowful 
expression. Amore."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Her kindness is enough to make my heart 
ache...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It feels like my heart's the one that's 
going to get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Besides, look! I'm completely animato, as 
you can see! Truly, there's no pain at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I'd rather ask for a dal 
segno. Is that out of the question?"
choice_data_list: Okay, but don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. When such a tone resonates, how could 
I not...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A melodía full of tenderness for me. It is 
truly dear to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Calmato... Let us follow this pausa and 
take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I need you to get well soon so I can see 
your smile again.
Sounds of Earth quietly got some rest.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Of course.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It might be starting to hurt again a 
little...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I wanted to show you how full of 
energy I am to put you at ease, but...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fermata. Looks like I need to get some 
proper rest.

Despite putting on a cheerful front, 
Sounds of Earth seemed to have aggravated 
her injury. She quietly took it easy and 
rested.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: See? Just like that.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I have no problem moving around at this 
level. ...I feel refreshed, too.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, to see you smile again... nothing 
could make me happier.

Sounds of Earth overcame her injury and 
made a smooth return.
